title: Quantitative Mapping of Insulin Hormone Maturation via Soft X-Ray Tomography
content: Understanding the relationship between cellular structure and function is a major challenge in cell biology. Recent advancements in mesoscale imaging, such as Soft X-Ray Tomography (SXT), have opened new avenues for exploring this relationship. SXT provides detailed 3D images of organelle organization and their biochemical states, offering a method for comparing cell organization across different conditions. This allows us to study how cells respond as integrated systems.
